verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with bearer-token authentication, a Careers Site API, webhooks and llms.txt/markdown docs, but no official SDK or client library in any language. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 at all candidate paths, so there is no published spec from which clients could be generated. A raw HTTP API is a building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
